versions.changelog: Added changelog section, fixed version in frontmatter
Generalized all agent names in examples

Initial release — track and optimize token usage and costs across all your OpenClaw agents:
- Real-time monitoring of token usage and cost per agent
- Automated alerts when approaching budget thresholds
- Daily and weekly cost reports with suggestions for saving money
- Model usage and cost breakdown, including free/paid model support
- Built-in optimization tips and easy configuration of alert levels and reporting
